Title: Please Sir
Body: You've just finished your daily ration of porridge but still feeling very hungry.

Title: New Kid on the Block
Body: A new orphan just arrived at the orphanage.

Title: No Good at Goodbyes
Body: You feel salty after hearing that another orphan found a new home today, making him the fourth child to be adopted this week.
Narrative 1: When another orphan was adopted ahead of me, I lashed out and called him a loser.
Narrative 2: Despite my dejection, I wished a fellow orphan all the best as he left the orphanage with his new family.
Narrative 3: I attempted an escape from the orphanage by hiding inside the luggage of an adopted orphan, but quickly got discovered when nobody could lift the suitcase.
Narrative 4: I asked an orphan who was adopted to come back and visit the orphanage so we could see each other again.

Title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
Body: You're awakened in the night by strange sounds, and as your eyes adjust to the darkness, you witness two older orphans in one bed, making funny noises.
Narrative 1: A couple of the older orphans, who were sharing a bed, told me to go back to sleep when I asked about the strange noises that woke me up.
Narrative 2: I went back to sleep after a couple of orphans woke me up with their strange noises.
Narrative 3: A couple of orphans who were sharing a bed woke me up with their strange noises, and I watched them in the darkness.
Narrative 4: I told the staff about two older orphans who were sharing a bed and making funny noises that woke me up.

Title: A Big Bully
Body: You just witnessed an older orphan bullying a younger orphan by saying that no one will ever adopt him.
Narrative 1: I told a bully that he was a worthless coward for making younger orphans feel bad.
Narrative 2: I reported a bully to the staff for picking on a fellow orphan.
Choice 3: Stand up for the young orphan
Narrative 3: I stood up for a younger orphan who was getting bullied by an older orphan.
Narrative 4: I acquired a dead fish and put it under a bully's pillow after witnessing him picking on a younger orphan.

Title: Self Improvement
Body: You've been brainstorming ideas on how to make yourself more adoptable.\240

Title: 30-Day Warranty
Body: One of the orphans, who was recently adopted, was just returned to the orphanage and appears to be quite sad.
Narrative 1: I comforted an orphan who was returned to the orphanage after the family decided they no longer wanted her.
Narrative 2: I made fun of an orphan who was returned to the orphanage after the family decided they no longer wanted her.

Title: Abuse of Power
Body: While eating in the mess hall, you witness a staff member verbally abusing a fellow orphan.

Title: Special orders
Body: The orphanage policy states that on your birthday (if known), you can order any food you want to eat.
